description: This script manages iOS team IDs for code signing, sourcing data from Xcode preferences, legacy defaults, provisioning profiles, and keychain, providing fallback and user prompts for missing data.

methods.name: detect_python
methods.description: Detects available Python interpreter from a list of candidates.

methods.name: append_team
methods.description: Adds a team ID, free status, and name to the respective arrays if not already present.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_preferences
methods.description: Loads team IDs from Xcode preferences plist, parsing JSON data.

methods.name: load_teams_from_legacy_defaults_key
methods.description: Loads team IDs from legacy defaults key.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_managed_profiles
methods.description: Loads team IDs from provisioning profiles by parsing embedded plist.

methods.name: has_xcode_account
methods.description: Checks if there is an active Xcode developer account.
